report_name: BBC LOCAL CYCLING & WALKING INFRASTRUCTURE PLAN PLUS
how_pct_was_used: The PCT was used as a layer of evidence to assist in the development of the cycle network by identifying promising areas for potential cycle growth and informing network development.
other_tools_developed: WSP GIS model using hexagon clustering, Route Selection Tool (RST), Walking Route Audit Tool (WRAT), and Active Mode Appraisal Toolkit (AMAT)
specific_evidence_of_impact: The PCT analysis and stakeholder workshops led to the identification of a cycle network map, the prioritization of specific routes (such as the Basildon East-West Link and Billericay to Basildon corridor), and the revision of infrastructure proposals to align with LTN 1/20 standards, such as replacing toucan crossings with signalized pedestrian/cycle crossings.
pct_usage_quote: For this study the top five straight line desire lines between Census Local Super Output Areas (LSOAs) were determined, applying the ‘Go Dutch Scenario’ which considers the increase in cycle users if England had the same infrastructure and cycling culture as the Netherlands.
combined_authority_name: Association of South Essex Local Authorities
